title: Qwen3.8 max - Alibaba just dropped a 2.4T param model and it's open source
description:
Qwen3.8-Max just landed and the benchmarks are hard to ignore.

2.4 trillion total parameters. ~95 billion active per token. That's the MoE trick — only 4% of the model fires on each token, which is why it can be frontier-quality without frontier-level compute costs.

Here's what it actually does:

🏆 Benchmark leads (vs GPT-5.6 Sol, Fable 5, DeepSeek V4, Kimi K3):
→ FrontierSWE (software engineering): 73.5 — #1
→ PaperBench (research): 93.0 — #1
→ OSWorld (computer use / agents): 86.1 — #1
→ IFBench (instruction following): 82.8 — #1

⚙️ Key capabilities:
→ 1 million token context window (128k output)
→ Adjustable reasoning: low / medium / xhigh thinking modes
→ 500+ turn long-horizon agent planning demonstrated
→ Open weights releasing on HuggingFace + ModelScope

💰 Pricing:
→ $2 / M input tokens
→ $6 / M output tokens
→ $0.25 / M cached — massive cuts for agentic workloads
→ Undercuts Kimi K3 ($15 out) at the same capability tier

One thing to note: GPT-5.6 Sol still leads on GPQA Diamond (94.1 vs 92.6). Not a sweep — but the coding and agent results are real.
